items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: Who? McCoy Brothers. Charlie and Joe. They went off to Chicago, I think. So, you might not have known them.

ctx.x: The McCoy Brothers. Did you ever know them?

Who? McCoy Brothers. Charlie and Joe. They went off to Chicago, I think. So, you might not have known them. Did you ever go to Dockery's Plantation? No. No. Did you ever go to Dockery's Plantation? No. No. A lot of guys played around there. Yeah. I did that. And then Big Joe Williams, he played around Mississippi. You know him, huh? Yeah. Didn't you? Yeah. I did that. He had nine strings of dogs on him. What about banjo players? Did they have any banjo players up there? No. No. No. No. Did you ever play with…
